directions: Cook the pasta according to package directions. Reserve 1/4 cup of pasta water, then drain and set pasta aside.
Blend the cottage cheese, milk, and seasonings (garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, salt, pepper, cornstarch) until smooth.

Pour the sauce into the pasta pot, add the shredded cheddar cheese, and heat over medium-low heat, stirring to melt the cheese. When the sauce begins to simmer, reduce heat to low and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the pasta back into the pot and mix with the cheese sauce. If the sauce is too thick, add a bit of the reserved pasta water to achieve the desired cheesy consistency. Serve warm.
Storage: Once cooled, refrigerate leftovers. To reheat, add a couple of tablespoons of milk and microwave until warm, stopping a few times to stir.
